Generated DWARF headers identify Contrib/Contrib/fmodstudiosrc11005/lowlevel_api and platforms/nx headers. See research.md; this is family evidence, not source-file ownership or exact SDK/compiler version proof.

NSS defines FLAC__stream_decoder_* and FLAC__bitreader_* alongside the audio region. Distinctive API family identifies codec only; integration, upstream revision and original translation units remain unverified. See research.md.

Committed DemonWare libtomcrypt headers and bdHash/bdHMac callers establish the API family; NSS defines the crypto functions and ltc_mp/ltm_desc data. Generic internal names are deliberately unmatched. No upstream release or exact original source path is asserted. See research.md.

NSS contains the mp_* API cluster and ltm_desc/ltc_mp data, corroborating a TomMath-compatible backend used with the crypto family. Generic arithmetic and descriptor adapters remain unmatched. Exact upstream version, build configuration and original ownership require recovery. See research.md.

Direct NSS DWARF DIEs 0x81427 and 0x81a03 establish ErrorStack.cpp declaration paths and exact address extents. Their enclosing System_Debug.cpp CU omits both extents from its ranges; existing generator uses CU ranges. Preserve unresolved canonical ownership pending a reviewed fallback/policy. See research.md.
